ANGLE.description: View Angle (ANGLE). Rotates the model view by converting horizontal and vertical angles into an axis vector; both angles drive the resulting view orientation.

Argument.description: View angle request. Although both fields are optional in the DTO, the handler rejects the request unless both HORIZONTAL and VERTICAL are supplied.

HORIZONTAL.description: Horizontal rotation angle (degrees) used with VERTICAL to compute the view axis vector. Must be assigned or the request is rejected.

VERTICAL.description: Vertical rotation angle (degrees) used with HORIZONTAL to compute the view axis vector. Must be assigned or the request is rejected.
